title: Pixel Index layout.shared event, version 1
description: The JSON body delivered to one subscription when an authenticated Pixel Index user shares a layout. The envelope is stable across event types; data contains the layout.shared-specific snapshot.

eventId.description: Globally unique id for the logical share event. It is unchanged across subscriptions and delivery retries; a receiver with multiple subscriptions deduplicates on subscriptionId plus eventId.

eventType.description: Stable event routing key. Consumers must ignore event types they do not support.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this event payload contract. A breaking contract change uses a new version rather than changing version 1 in place.

occurredAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which Pixel Index accepted the share action. It describes the event, not an individual delivery attempt, and is unchanged on retry.

subscriptionId.description: Non-secret id of the subscription receiving this payload. The subscription secret is used only to authenticate the HTTP delivery and is never included in the body.

data.description: Snapshot of the share-specific data at occurredAt.

sharerDiscordId.description: Discord user id of the authenticated user who invoked Share. This is the actor and can differ from the layout owner.

owner.description: Server-resolved owner identity at the time of the event. It is a display snapshot, not client-supplied authorship data.

discordId.description: Stable Discord user id of the owner. Absent only for legacy credited layouts whose owner is not linked to a Discord account.

username.description: Discord username, or the legacy author credit for an unlinked layout, captured when the event was created.

displayName.description: Guild nickname, then Discord global display name, then username; for an unlinked layout, the legacy author credit.

layout.description: Complete layout.json value shared inline. It is an immutable event-time snapshot and remains usable even when the layout has not been published.

publication.description: Whether this layout was publicly retrievable when the event was created. The published URL is present exactly when published is true.

published.description: The layout was publicly retrievable when this event was created.

url.description: Absolute URL of the public Pixel Index layout-detail API resource. It may stop resolving if the layout is later hidden or deleted.

published.description: The layout had no publicly retrievable Pixel Index resource when this event was created.
